name: purchasing
title_zh: 审批单没走完，采购订单一张都建不出来
tagline_zh: 采购流程卡在口头确认？它把「谁批了才能建单」焊死在工具里。审批链没闭环。
tagline_en: Tired of POs created before approvals? This skill hard-wires 'approved first' into the tool—no closed approval.
desc_en: Create approved purchase orders with the create-purchase-order tool
why_zh: 把审批状态当输入参数而非事后备注，机制上杜绝「先斩后奏」。适合审计严格、流程敏感的企业环境。
why_en: Treats approval status as a gate, not a footnote—structurally prevents unauthorized orders. Built for audit-heavy.
limit_zh: 只认 create-purchase-order 一个工具；不负责审批流本身，审批状态需由外部系统传入。
limit_en: Only gates create-purchase-order; approval workflow must be fed externally. Without upstream approval data, it simply refuses—no reminders, no drafts.
